title: Pablo Mera takes another step with Real Madrid first-team exposure
summary: Pablo Mera continues to build momentum inside the Real Madrid structure, combining strong youth-team visibility with recent first-team exposure during the pre-season period.
content: Pablo Mera is gaining important visibility within the Real Madrid basketball pathway. After standing out in youth and national-team contexts, he has recently been connected with the first-team environment during pre-season, reinforcing his status as one of the most interesting young Spanish guard prospects to monitor.
